replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body:
If I were to judge it based on gameplay from other maps I would say that the hallways are too narrow the reason that I say that is because take maps like Alpha Complex. The walkways aren't to narrow so that no one can get by but they aren't to wide so that fighting in them will be a bore. So I would say try to make the hallways a little wider for the best optimized gameplay.

(This is just based on past maps and pictures but I will take your word for it and download it when it becomes available.)
